title: Lake Hartwell Wildlife Safari
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Lake Hartwell Wildlife Safari is an exciting, family friendly drive through safari experience! Drive your own vehicle, or rent one of safari vehicles to view, feed and even pet the animals. We also have a petting zoo, budgie experience, tortoises and monkeys for even more fun. Inexpensive family fun. Stop in our gift shop to support the animal lover in your life. The Safari is located near Lake Hartwell, Anderson,
